name: Corner automatic balance firmware (BAUTO corner mode)

tests.firmware_harness: passed (corner auto suite: arming prerequisites, entry gates, tilt retry, third-axis full-speed retry, overspeed exit)
tests.upper_computer: passed (38 cases incl. corner profile load and corner auto gating)
tests.corner_diagnostic: passed (18 cases incl. 8 simulated auto long-run cases)

corner_auto.arm: BAUTO 1 [3..15 seconds]; corner needs all three axes aligned, directions confirmed, reference and L>BFULL
corner_auto.entry: pose within 3 deg of the fixed reference, low body rate, all three wheels below 5 rad/s, stable for 1 s, then PG5 countdown
corner_auto.retry: tilt beyond 20 deg or any wheel at or above 250 rad/s for 3 s disarms, waits 1 s and re-enters automatically; no run deadline
corner_auto.hard_exit: wheel above L (overspeed), body rate above 3 rad/s, sensor/heartbeat/stall faults stop and exit automatic mode

post_flash_state: App:0, BMode:1, Bal:0, Cal:0, Aligned:000, EN:000, Fault:0, CornerStart:1, YawTune:1, EncType:0(i2c)
post_flash_actions_required: three-axis self-test (TEST 1/2/3), static IMU calibration (CAL_IMU), then load the verified corner profile before arming BAUTO
